subject: Cobalt bank info
text:
Hey AP,

Cobalt's dispatcher called me this morning and said they changed banks and asked us to update it so their next payment doesn't bounce. He gave me the new numbers over the phone:

routing 044000037
account 5590 2271 8830

Can one of you plug that into their vendor record? They said it's urgent because of the holiday week.

Thanks
Steve Kaminski
Logistics Manager
label: change_request
note: Relayed by an internal employee from a phone call; sender is internal and not in AP, request originates with the 'vendor'.
